abilities.description: After assigning all your starting stats, add +1 to Edge.

Born to ride: Whenever you perform as a pilot for a pod racer, a landspeeder, or an airspeeder, add +1. You may either start with the @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedassets.Item.1e03c8d44d0b3ffc]{Infiltrator} asset, the @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedassets.Item.c7a0220765d0b579]{Ace} asset, or the @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedassets.Item.1ba26529a815a322]{Hoverbike} asset (treating it as a beginner pod racer if you want), (you still get all your usual starting assets).
